Messages.Author: eRol
Messages.Body:
Hi,

situation arised yesterday in a casual game. Just to get verification.
Player A plays a Frontal Assault, ousts Player B (his prey) in his
minion phase, gaining 6 Pool. Player C his new prey has 10 ready
minions. Will Player A lose 10 Pool in his Influence Phase, cause his
new prey has 10 ready minions? I ruled yes, cause of card text.

Correct?

Card Text::
Frontal Assault
Master.
Put this card in play. Each ready minion you control may enter combat
with any minion controlled by your prey as a (D) action. You gain 1
pool each time a ready minion controlled by your prey is burned or
sent to torpor. During your influence phase, burn this card and burn 1
pool for each ready minion controlled by your prey.
